title: Efficient Safety Alignment of Large Language Models via Preference Re-ranking and Representation-based Reward Modeling
benchmark_measurement: Not applicable. The paper focuses on general safety and toxicity, not specific aspects of faith or religion.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion. Its focus is on a new method for efficient safety alignment of large language models.
